findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_list" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "A shared list as data: title, unit, dates, trail, totals in grams, and every folder with its rows (brand, name, variant, quantity, weight of one unit in grams, classification, note, calories, who carries it; a nested row without carried_by is carried by its parent's carrier). Takes a share code or s" → after: "A shared list by its share code or link, as data or as Markdown; or, with no share_code, the lists filed under the connector's account. Data, the default: title, unit, dates, trail, totals in grams, and every folder with its rows (brand, name, variant, quantity, weight of one unit in grams, classifi"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
